sources.title: LiteRT-LM - Google's Edge LLM Inference Framework | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: LiteRT-LM is Google's orchestration layer for running large language models on top of LiteRT, the on-device runtime that succeeded TensorFlow Lite.
